module Main where

import Control.Exception (evaluate)
import Control.Monad (replicateM_)
import Data.Either (isLeft)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import Hol.V1.Bytecode
import Hol.V1.FullBytecode
import qualified X.Machine as Native
import System.Environment (getArgs)
import Text.Printf (printf)
import Z.System.File (readFileNow)

timed :: IO a -> IO (a, Double)
timed action = do
    begin <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    value <- action
    end <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    return (value, fromIntegral (end - begin) / 1000000)

main :: IO ()
main = do
    [path] <- getArgs
    replicateM_ 12 $ do
        (input, reading) <- timed (readFileNow path)
        source <- maybe (ioError (userError "read failed")) return input
        (notFull, fullProbe) <- timed (evaluate (isLeft (deserializeFullBytecode source)))
        (program, decoding) <- timed (either (ioError . userError) return (deserializeBytecode source))
        (_, revalidating) <- timed (either (ioError . userError) return (validateBytecode program))
        (machine, creating) <- timed (Native.createMachine (bytecodeWords program))
        (answer, first) <- timed (Native.nextAnswer machine)
        (rest, exhaust) <- timed (Native.nextAnswer machine)
        (_, closing) <- timed (Native.closeMachine machine)
        case (notFull, answer, rest) of
            (True, Right (Just encoded), Right Nothing) -> printf "read=%.6f full_probe=%.6f decode_validate=%.6f revalidate=%.6f create=%.6f first=%.6f exhaust=%.6f close=%.6f answer_words=%d\n" reading fullProbe decoding revalidating creating first exhaust closing (length encoded)
            other -> print other

module Main where

import Control.Monad (replicateM_)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import Hol.V1.Bytecode
import qualified Hol.V1.Main as V1
import qualified Hol.V1.Runtime as Runtime
import qualified X.Machine as Native
import System.Environment (getArgs)
import System.IO (hFlush, stderr, stdout)
import Text.Printf (hPrintf)
import Z.System.File (readFileNow)
import Z.Utils (execUniqueT)

timed :: IO a -> IO (a, Double)
timed action = do
    begin <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    value <- action
    end <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    return (value, fromIntegral (end - begin) / 1000000)

main :: IO ()
main = do
    [path] <- getArgs
    replicateM_ 12 $ do
        source <- readFileNow path >>= maybe (ioError (userError "read failed")) return
        program <- either (ioError . userError) return (deserializeBytecode source)
        Native.withMachine (bytecodeWords program) $ \machine -> do
            answer <- Native.nextAnswer machine
            case answer of
                Right (Just encoded) -> do
                    (binding, decoding) <- timed (execUniqueT (Runtime.decodeAnswer program encoded) >>= either (ioError . userError) return)
                    (_, printing) <- timed (V1.printBytecodeAnswer 1 binding >> hFlush stdout)
                    hPrintf stderr "decode_answer=%.6f render_and_flush=%.6f\n" decoding printing
                other -> ioError (userError (show other))

differential_validation.normalization: Preserve query IDs < query_slots exactly; alpha-rename fresh IDs per answer by first occurrence; compare every slot and binding membership in ordered full answer sequences.
differential_validation.description: Independent deterministic bounded first-order wordcode differential correctness check; not a timing benchmark.
differential_validation.candidate_source_equivalence: The tested candidate is /tmp/ppap-speed3/machine-head-env.c. Current src/X/machine.c differs only by two explanatory comments: initial-query fresh representatives and completion of body slots before entry. Token sequences after stripping C block comments match exactly.

method.generator: Python random.Random(seed), 5000 consecutive deterministic seeds; Builder extracted using ast from test/v1/native_fixtures.py.
method.programs: Query has 1–3 slots; predicates p/2 and q/1 each have 2–4 clauses. Structured/repeated head variables, body-only variables, depth-bounded terms and bodies, CHOICE/UNIFY/CUT/FAIL and finite p-to-q calls; q cannot recurse.
method.lifetime_stress: Every third seed forces the first p clause to bind the same body-only variable in both arms of a body CHOICE. Other cases exercise head subtree materialization and repeated-variable sharing.
method.execution: Load baseline and candidate as separate shared libraries via ctypes. Create one machine per program, enumerate through complete exhaustion, verify stable exhaustion, always destroy in finally.
method.comparison: Compare complete ordered sequences, including answer count, constant/term structure, variable sharing, all query slot identities and binding membership. Only fresh IDs at or above query_slots are alpha-normalized by first appearance separately per answer.
method.bounds: Native result bound 10000 per case; generated programs have no recursion. Assertion failures save seed, full wordcode, and observed answers.
method.scope: Correctness differential against previous VM implementation, not an independent declarative semantics oracle and not exhaustive over all valid wordcode.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded generated wordcode differential checks for native VM changes."""

import argparse
import ast
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import random
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path


root = Path('/home/lim/portfolio/ppap')
module = ast.parse((root / 'test/v1/native_fixtures.py').read_text())
builder = next(node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'Builder')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[builder], type_ignores=[]), '<fixture Builder>', 'exec'))


class Native:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.library = ctypes.CDLL(str(Path(path).resolve()))
        for name, arguments, result in [
            ('create', [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64), ctypes.c_size_t], ctypes.c_void_p),
            ('next', [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_int),
            ('answer_size', [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_size_t),
            ('answer', [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int64), ctypes.c_size_t], ctypes.c_int),
            ('error', [ctypes.c_void_p], ctypes.c_char_p),
            ('destroy', [ctypes.c_void_p], None),
        ]:
            function = getattr(self.library, 'hol_v1_' + name)
            function.argtypes = arguments
            function.restype = result
            setattr(self, name, function)

    def answers(self, words):
        code = (ctypes.c_int64 * len(words))(*words)
        machine = self.create(code, len(words))
        assert machine, 'machine allocation failed'
        result = []
        try:
            for _ in range(10001):
                status = self.next(machine)
                if status == 0:
                    assert self.next(machine) == 0, 'exhaustion must remain stable'
                    return result
                assert status > 0, self.error(machine).decode()
                if status == 2:
                    continue
                count = self.answer_size(machine)
                output = (ctypes.c_int64 * count)()
                assert self.answer(machine, output, count) == 1
                result.append(normalize(list(output), words[5]))
            raise AssertionError('bounded program exceeded 10000 native results')
        finally:
            self.destroy(machine)


def normalize(words, query_slots):
    offset = 0
    fresh = {}

    def term():
        nonlocal offset
        tag = words[offset]
        offset += 1
        if tag == 2:
            return ('app', term(), term())
        value = words[offset]
        offset += 1
        if tag == 1:
            return ('const', value)
        assert tag == 0 and value >= 0
        if value < query_slots:
            return ('query', value)
        return ('fresh', fresh.setdefault(value, len(fresh)))

    terms = tuple(term() for _ in range(query_slots))
    assert offset == len(words)
    # Initial variable identity is intentionally retained, including whether
    # a visible query slot has a binding rather than mapping to itself.
    membership = tuple(value != ('query', index) for index, value in enumerate(terms))
    return terms, membership


def generate(seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    b = Builder(rng.randint(1, 3))
    constants = [b.c(index) for index in range(8)]
    variables = [b.v(index) for index in range(7)]
    ret, failure = b.i(0), b.i(1)

    def term(slots, depth=2):
        pick = rng.random()
        if slots and pick < 0.60:
            return variables[rng.randrange(slots)]
        if depth and pick < 0.84:
            constructor = constants[rng.choice([2, 3])]
            arguments = [term(slots, depth - 1) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 2))]
            return b.apps(constructor, *arguments)
        return constants[rng.randrange(4, 8)]

    def body(slots, depth, next_pc=ret, calls=True):
        if not depth:
            return next_pc
        pick = rng.random()
        if pick < 0.23:
            return b.i(4, body(slots, depth - 1, next_pc, calls), body(slots, depth - 1, next_pc, calls))
        continuation = body(slots, depth - 1, next_pc, calls)
        if pick < 0.35:
            return b.i(5, continuation)
        if pick < 0.42:
            return failure
        if calls and pick < 0.65:
            return b.i(2, b.app(constants[1], term(slots)), continuation)
        if pick < 0.85:
            return b.i(3, variables[rng.randrange(slots)], term(slots), continuation)
        return continuation

    for index in range(rng.randint(2, 4)):
        slots = rng.randint(2, 6)
        if index == 0:
            # Frequently exercise repeated variables and deferred structure
            # construction; reserve the final slot for body-only variables.
            head_arguments = rng.choice([
                [variables[0], variables[0]],
                [variables[0], variables[1]],
                [b.app(constants[2], variables[0]), variables[0]],
                [variables[0], b.app(constants[2], variables[0])],
            ])
        else:
            head_arguments = [term(slots - 1), term(slots - 1)]
        entry = body(slots, rng.randint(1, 3))
        if seed % 3 == 0 and index == 0:
            # The same body-only cell is instantiated on both sides of a
            # choice. Restoring a stale lazy cell would lose its heap node.
            hidden = variables[slots - 1]
            entry = b.i(4, b.i(3, hidden, constants[4], entry), b.i(3, hidden, constants[5], entry))
        b.cs.append((0, slots, b.apps(constants[0], *head_arguments), entry))

    for index in range(rng.randint(2, 4)):
        slots = rng.randint(1, 3)
        argument = variables[0] if index == 0 else term(slots)
        b.cs.append((1, slots, b.app(constants[1], argument), body(slots, rng.randint(0, 2), calls=False)))

    args = [variables[0], variables[min(1, b.q - 1)]] if seed % 2 else [term(b.q), term(b.q)]
    continuation = body(b.q, rng.randint(0, 2))
    entry = b.i(2, b.apps(constants[0], *args), continuation)
    if seed % 4 == 0:
        entry = b.i(4, entry, b.i(2, b.apps(constants[0], term(b.q), term(b.q)), ret))
    return b.code(entry)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('baseline')
    parser.add_argument('candidate')
    parser.add_argument('--count', type=int, default=5000)
    parser.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=20261110)
    parser.add_argument('--output', default='/tmp/ppap-speed3/differential-results.json')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    baseline, candidate = Native(args.baseline), Native(args.candidate)
    statistics = Counter()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for case in range(args.count):
        seed = args.seed + case
        words = generate(seed)
        digest.update(json.dumps(words).encode())
        try:
            before = baseline.answers(words)
            after = candidate.answers(words)
            assert before == after, 'complete alpha-normalized answer sequences differ'
        except Exception as error:
            failure = dict(seed=seed, words=words, error=str(error), before=locals().get('before'), after=locals().get('after'))
            Path(args.output).with_suffix('.failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(failure, indent=4))
            raise
        statistics['cases'] += 1
        statistics['answers'] += len(before)
        statistics['nonempty_cases' if before else 'empty_cases'] += 1
        statistics['multiple_answers_cases'] += len(before) > 1
        statistics['residual_answers'] += sum('fresh' in repr(answer) for answer in before)
        statistics['structured_answers'] += sum('app' in repr(answer) for answer in before)
    summary = dict(seed_start=args.seed, seed_count=args.count, generated_wordcode_sha256=digest.hexdigest(), statistics=statistics,
        baseline_library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(args.baseline).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        candidate_library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(args.candidate).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        normalization='Preserve query IDs < query_slots exactly; alpha-rename fresh IDs per answer by first occurrence; compare every slot and binding membership in ordered full answer sequences.')
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=4) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=4))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
